description: Async/await backend conformance tests — verifies runtime behavior with expectedExitCode assertions.

tests.name: async-simple-await
tests.description: Simple async function with await returns correct result
tests.source:
async function g(): int { return 42; }
export async function f(): int { return await g(); }

tests.name: async-sync-complete
tests.description: Async function without internal await completes synchronously
tests.source: export async function f(): int { return 5; }

tests.name: async-error-propagation
tests.description: Error in awaited function propagates through await
tests.source:
async function inner(): int { throw { code: "E_INNER", message: "inner error" }; return 0; }
export async function outer(): string { try { let _: int = await inner(); return "no error"; } catch (e) { return e.code; } }

tests.name: async-nested-await
tests.description: Nested async calls (A awaits B awaits C) work

tests.name: async-nullable-return
tests.description: Async function with nullable return type
tests.source: export async function f(): string | null { return null; }

tests.name: async-with-params
tests.source:
async function add(a: int, b: int): int { return a + b; }
export async function compute(): int { return await add(1, 2); }

tests.name: async-throw-catch
tests.description: throw inside async caught by catch in same async
tests.source: export async function f(): string { try { throw { code: "E_TEST", message: "test error" }; return "unreachable"; } catch (e) { return e.code; } }

tests.name: async-multiple-awaits
